In a skillet, sauté 2 minced garlic cloves in 2 Tbsp olive oil 30 s, add ½ lb peeled shrimp, cook 2 min per side, stir in zest/juice of 1 lemon, ¼ cup white wine (optional), and a pinch of red‑pepper flakes.
